schedule.title: Working hours aren't set up yet
schedule.description: This is where everyone's reachable hours line up on a single timezone axis, so you can see when the team actually overlaps and find a slot to talk.

leave.title: No time off recorded yet
leave.description: A month at a glance of who is away and when — including half days, team events, and the public holidays of each member's own region.

allocation.title: Nobody is allocated to a project yet
allocation.description: How each person's time is split across projects, so the same person is never counted as full-time by two of them at once.

slot_finder.title: Find a time everyone is free
slot_finder.core: Core hours — everyone has said you may interrupt them
slot_finder.working: Working hours — everyone is at work
slot_finder.no_core: No shared core hours this week.
slot_finder.no_working: No shared working hours this week.
slot_finder.undeclared: {{names}} hasn't declared any hours, so no slot can include them.

wallchart.confirm_cancel: Cancel this {{name}}? There is no undo.

form.reason_privacy: Only you, your approver and workspace admins can read this.

allocation.admin_only: Only workspace admins can change these.
allocation.hint: How each person's week is split. The total cannot exceed 100% — the server refuses it.

settings.my_hours_hint: What you declare about your own week. Only you can change this — an admin setting it for you would not be a declaration.
settings.calendars_hint: Working weekdays, time zone, public holidays and make-up workdays, per region.
settings.leave_types_hint: Types are retired, never deleted — a type that has been used is part of the record of who was away.
settings.core_hint: The narrower window you commit to being interruptible in. Leave both blank if your whole working day is fair game.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.assumed: Nobody is allocated yet, so everyone is counted at 100%.
capacity.undeclared: {{count}} member(s) have not set working hours, so they count as zero.
capacity.no_dates: This cycle has no start or end date, so capacity cannot be worked out.
capacity.points_note: This project estimates in points, so committed work cannot be compared with hours.
